profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorganChase
profile.summary:
Holding dual B.S. degrees in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences, along with an M.S. and Ph.D. in Electrical and Computer Engineering, Jonghyun has authored 15 publications in advanced computer networking, MANETs, and performance modeling. His research spans from jamming‑aware routing protocols to predictive link‑quality estimation, reflecting a career‑long commitment to solving complex, real‑world networking challenges.

As one of the earliest members of Cloudamize, Jonghyun architected and built the company’s core data collection and analytics products from the ground up—laying the technical foundation that fueled the company’s rapid growth and eventual acquisition by Blackstone and Atos. He continued to lead R&D on Cloudamize’s flagship technologies, driving innovation that enables organizations to achieve agile, scalable operations through cloud migration.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, an Eviden business
positions.description: Lead R&D engineer for data collection and analytics, responsible for developing workload‑based mapping from customer on‑premises machines to cloud virtual machines using performance metrics for CPU, memory, disk, and network. Delivers an accurate recommendation and mapping service that enables customers to estimate annual costs after migrating to the recommended virtual machines in Cloud Service Providers (CSPs).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, a Cloudreach business
positions.description:
Cloudreach is acquired by Atos.
Lead data collection and analytics developer for network application inter‑connectivity, agent‑ and agentless‑based data collection, and on‑cloud data collection from major Cloud Service Providers. Developed core Cloudamize platform capabilities enabling TCO comparison across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, automated application discovery and dependency mapping, optimal migration planning, and cost visibility—empowering faster, more confident cloud adoption and maximizing ROI.

positions.title: Senior Research Scientist
positions.description:
Cloudamize is acquired by Blackstone and Cloudreach.
Lead data analytics developer for the network application inter-connectivity system, which maps application‑level interconnection topologies across all customer machines. This visualization of network application inter-connections enables companies to plan and execute migrations to Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) more efficiently, reducing risk and improving decision‑making.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented an efficient jamming-aware routing protocol based on the Optimized Link State Routing (OLSR) protocol.
- Developed a model to efficiently evaluate network flooding performance with proactive retransmissions across various flooding methods in mobile ad hoc networks.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented cross-layer routing protocols using C/C++ to leverage cooperative path diversity in mobile ad hoc networks.
- Developed a mobility simulator using C++ that generates realistic mobile node traces in urban environments based on Discrete Event Simulation (DES) techniques.
- Developed a detection method for Peer-to-Peer (P2P) application flows, which is crucial for network capacity planning and traffic shaping.
- Designed and evaluated various IEEE 802.11-style Medium Access Control (MAC) algorithms, each utilizing different amounts of channel usage information from mobile nodes.
- Conducted wireless signal measurements on Cisco and Tropos routers using a separate laptop equipped with an Atheros chipset and the MadWifi device driver.
